rundown: Gators beat Seminoles 81-72 at Tucker Center in Tallahassee, FL. Gators led 31-29 at half-time and never looked back. By ESPN's win probability it was never really in doubt (never below 74%).
Leading the way — Gators: Thomas Haugh 21 pts, 10 reb; Boogie Fland 4 ast. Seminoles: Sebastian Rancik 23 pts; Anthony Robinson II 3 ast; Shon Abaev 6 reb.
Where Gators won it: they shot 32% from three to 19%, won the boards 41-29 and had 11 assists to 7.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Gators closed as 8.5-point favorites and covered by 0.5; the total closed at 164.5 and they combined for 153, under by 11.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 10, 5:52 PM ET. It had Gators 64% and Seminoles 36%, projecting Gators 80.8 – Seminoles 76.9 (157.7 total, Gators by 3.9).

Final: Gators 81 – Seminoles 72. Right winner: it had Gators at 64%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Gators came in with a 12% above average attack and a 14% stingier than average defense (2-0, 82.5 scored and 62 allowed a game over 2 games), worth about 170 and 170 games of evidence. Projected to score 80.8, they scored 81 (+0.2 points, 0% over); projected to allow 76.9, they allowed 72 (−4.9 points, 6% under).

Seminoles came in with a 11% above average attack and a 5% stingier than average defense (2-0, 101.5 scored and 68.5 allowed a game over 2 games), worth about 170 and 170 games of evidence. Projected to score 76.9, they scored 72 (−4.9 points, 6% under); projected to allow 80.8, they allowed 81 (+0.2 points, 0% over).

The bigger miss was Seminoles' scoring (-4.9 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 153 against 157.7 projected (-4.7), about the 37th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±14.5).

Margin: Gators by 9 against Gators by 3.9 projected, about the 32nd percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±11).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
FSU ML (+370) at +370: the algo gave it 22% vs 20% fair (+1.6 pts), THE PICK — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 20%). FLA ML (-485) at -485: the algo gave it 78% vs 80% fair (-1.6 pts) — won (+0.2u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 80%). FSU +8.5 (-105) at -105: the algo gave it 51% vs 49% fair (+1.7 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. FLA -8.5 (-115) at -115: the algo gave it 49% vs 51% fair (-1.7 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. OVER 163.5 (-115) at -115: the algo gave it 49% vs 51% fair (-1.7 pts) — lost (-1u); beat the closing 164.5 by 1. UNDER 163.5 (-105) at -105: the algo gave it 51% vs 49% fair (+1.7 pts) — won (+1u); lost to the closing 164.5 by 1.

From the algo's snapshot to the close: total 163.5 → 164.5. The total moved away from the algo's number.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 60% of bets on Gators, 37% of the money — Gators covered; total: 66% of bets on the over, 57% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 96% of bets on Gators, 87% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Seminoles, who lost and didn't cover.

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin.

The projection landed within its normal range anyway, so the flags didn't cost it much this time.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.977 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -4 points. It counts toward CBB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 269 graded CBB games the algo now scales scoring ×1.007 and gives home teams +1.1 points. Team corrections start after 3 graded games for a team.

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, the pick lost (-1u).
